title: Data for "When Forced to Choose, Language Models Condemn Spanking and the Death Penalty More Than Major Demographic Groups in the United States"
description: Data release for the paper (PNAS Nexus, under review). 81,000 responses from 30 large language models to the 15 behaviors of the Pew Research Center's 2025 moral-acceptability survey, in six prompt languages (English, Spanish, French, Mandarin, Hindi, Arabic), with six response-option orderings and five repetitions; parsed verdicts; Pew subgroup tables and margins of error; reason-type and moral-foundation labels from two classifiers; human validation codes; a free-text check; and a language-comprehension check. See README.md for the data dictionary.
